data.exact_reserve_text: No new business was written during 2024 and therefore the net claims incurred of $11,708,000 (2023: $6,360,000) represents a deterioration in the claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Unfavourable claims movements on inherited reserves from Syndicate 1969 leading to a deterioration (strengthening) of prior year reserves.
Unfavourable claims movements on the inherited 2018 YoA transferred via RITC contributing to reserve deterioration.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2024 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were $133.432m. During 2024 gross claims provisions were strengthened by $22.288m (16.71% of opening gross reserves), reflecting adverse claims development. The deterioration is attributed primarily to unfavourable development on inherited RITC portfolios (notably the 2017 & prior Syndicate 1969 reserves and the 2018 Syndicate 3330 YoA), concentrated in third-party liability / casualty lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are presented in the report's native currency (USD). Opening reserves and prior year movement are taken from the Technical Provisions note and Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding). The syndicate executed RITC transactions (Syndicate 1969 and 3330) which materially affect reserve development and can distort development tables. Gross premiums are very small and include negative direct premium adjustments, producing large percentages relative to the small total premium; premiums are reported in thousands in the source. All amounts in this JSON are given in millions of USD (note key names use '_gbp_m' per requested schema but values are native currency).
